summary: On a live browser, moving on to the next chess puzzle read the board right after the tap, while the solved puzzle was still placed and loaded, so `nextPuzzleDifferent` reported the same puzzle again (puzzle-assistant trace 3 in every Verify Nightly browser run; it passed on virtual time). `moveOnToNextPuzzle` now waits for a different puzzle before the next one is read; a feed that really serves it again is still reported by the property.
